tasks.gr8-banking-saving-t4: Topic: Banking, saving and EMS consolidation. Cover banking services and functions, savings accounts and interest earned including compound interest, entrepreneurship qualities like resilience and adaptability, and integrated case studies connecting government, accounting, business structures, and banking. Ask Grade 8 learners to explain banking functions, calculate interest, identify entrepreneurial characteristics, and solve complex scenarios synthesizing all EMS Grade 8 concepts.
tasks.gr8-levels-functions-management-t4: Topic: Levels and functions of management. Cover the levels of management (top, middle, operational or supervisory), the four management tasks (planning, organising, leading, controlling) with a simple controlling example (actual minus planned), characteristics of good management (communicates clearly, is fair and honest, makes sound decisions, motivates workers, takes responsibility) and the three styles (autocratic, laissez-faire or permissive or free-rein, democratic or participatory) with advantages and disadvantages. Ask Grade 8 learners to name levels, tasks and styles from short scenarios.
tasks.gr8-general-ledger-trial-balance-t4: Topic: The General Ledger and Trial Balance of a service business. Cover the double-entry principle, T accounts (debit left, credit right), the sections of the General Ledger (Balance Sheet accounts and Nominal accounts), opening accounts, posting from the Cash Receipts Journal (debit Bank, credit the analysis account) and the Cash Payments Journal (credit Bank, debit the expense or asset), balancing accounts, and the Trial Balance (debit total equals credit total). Use the same business: bank debits R17 000, credits R5 100, balance R11 900 debit; trial balance totals R17 000. Ask Grade 8 learners to decide debit and credit, balance accounts and check a trial balance.
